verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a SaaS back-office platform for incorporation, compliance, accounting and banking, so a versioned public API with a deprecation policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence documents no public API, API versioning, or deprecation policy, and probes for OpenAPI specs at common paths all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
